hints.title: Target Sum Range
hints.text: The target sum S must be between 2 and 2 * limit inclusive.

hints.title: Interval Move Costs
hints.text: For pair (A, B) with A <= B: 2 moves for S outside [A + 1, B + limit], 1 move inside, and 0 moves at exact A + B.

hints.title: Difference Array Delta Technique
hints.text: Encode move cost adjustments onto a difference array diff and compute prefix sums to find the minimum.

hints.title: Full Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def minMoves(self, nums: list[int], limit: int) -> int:
        n = len(nums)
        diff = [0] * (2 * limit + 2)
        for i in range(n // 2):
            a, b = nums[i], nums[n - 1 - i]
            if a > b:
                a, b = b, a
            # default 2 moves for all sums: diff[2] += 2
            diff[2] += 2
            # 1 move range: a + 1 to b + limit
            diff[a + 1] -= 1
            # 0 move point: a + b
            diff[a + b] -= 1
            diff[a + b + 1] += 1
            # 2 move range resumes: b + limit + 1
            diff[b + limit + 1] += 1
        curr = 0
        ans = n
        for s in range(2, 2 * limit + 1):
            curr += diff[s]
            ans = min(ans, curr)
        return ans
```

variables: limit is upper bound on elements
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking every possible sum from 2 to 2 * limit takes O(n * limit), which is 10^10 operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Difference array records cost intervals in O(1) per pair, finding global minimum in O(limit) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate formulates interval boundaries [2, A + 1, A + B, B + limit + 1, 2 * limit] using prefix diffs.
